meta.title: The Fed Doesn't Print Money To Change Interest Rates. Here's What It Actually Does.
meta.hook: The Federal Reserve has never printed a dollar to raise or lower interest rates.
meta.description: The Federal Reserve sets a target range for the federal funds rate, then uses tools like the interest it pays banks on reserves to pull the real rate toward that target. No printing press involved. That single rate ripples out into mortgages, credit cards, savings accounts and business loans across the entire US economy. Educational content only, not financial advice.

scenes.narration: The Federal Reserve has never printed a dollar to raise or lower interest rates.

visual.visual_intent: The Federal Reserve building facade in Washington DC, low angle, overcast cinematic light
visual.decision_reason: hook beat: the building, hard cut

scenes.narration: What it actually does is set a target range for one specific rate: the rate banks charge each other overnight.

visual.visual_intent: A bank's secure vault interior, cool metallic light, slow pan across steel doors

scenes.narration: To hit that target, it changes the interest it pays banks on the reserves those banks already keep parked at the Fed.

visual.visual_intent: A dashboard of glowing financial rate figures adjusting on a dark screen, minimal cinematic render

scenes.narration: Raise that, and banks demand more to lend to each other. Lower it, and lending gets cheaper across the board.

visual.visual_intent: Two bankers shaking hands across a desk in a glass office, cool corporate light

scenes.narration: That one number then ripples outward into mortgage rates, credit card APRs, savings account yields, and business loans.

visual.visual_intent: An aerial pan over a suburban American neighborhood, warm late-day light
visual.decision_reason: the reach into everyday financial life

scenes.narration: No presses running. Just one rate, adjusted at a boardroom table, moving through the entire economy. Follow for more.

visual.visual_intent: An empty formal conference room table with microphones and name placards, dramatic overhead light
visual.decision_reason: the boardroom-to-economy scale payoff and CTA
